name: dice-roll
prompt: Five wooden dice shaken in a leather cup and spilled onto a felt-covered wooden table, rattling and settling with soft knocks.

name: die-hold
prompt: A single wooden die pressed down firmly onto a felt table with a soft muted thud.

name: die-release
prompt: A single wooden die lifted off a felt table with a faint tacky fabric release and a light tap.

name: score-points
prompt: A small brass scoring bell chiming once over a warm wooden counter knock, cheerful and satisfying.

name: score-avalanche
prompt: A cascading tumble of small stones and wooden tokens clattering down a wooden chute, bright and celebratory.

name: score-zero
prompt: A dull single knock of a wooden token set down on a felt table, flat and disappointing.

name: turn-start
prompt: A soft wooden card sliding across a felt table and stopping with a gentle tap.

name: invalid-move
prompt: A short muted knock of a wooden game piece bumped sideways against a table edge, dull and disapproving.

name: finish-cards
prompt: A triumphant cascade of small brass bells and wooden chimes ringing out over a cozy crackling fireplace.

name: finish-table
prompt: Two soft wooden mallets striking a marimba in a gentle descending phrase, warm and conclusive.

name: hint-chime
prompt: A single delicate glass chime note with a soft shimmer, light and suggestive.

name: undo-sweep
prompt: A quick reversed paper-and-felt whoosh, like a card being swept back across a table.

name: ui-click
prompt: A short crisp tap of a fingernail on a small polished wooden button.

name: countdown-tick
prompt: A single soft knock of a wooden mallet on a hollow wooden block in a quiet lodge room, short and round.

name: countdown-go
prompt: Two quick bright taps of a wooden mallet on a small brass bell, upbeat and inviting.

name: score-bonus
prompt: A warm rising three-note chord on a small glockenspiel followed by one soft brass bell strike, celebratory and cozy, indoors.

name: score-hand
prompt: Three quick ascending wooden xylophone notes followed by a soft satisfying knock of a wooden token on a felt table.

name: result-win
prompt: A short triumphant fireside fanfare of glockenspiel and soft brass bells rising together, warm and joyful, ending on a gentle shimmer.

name: result-lose
prompt: A gentle descending three-note phrase on a wooden marimba with a soft sigh of wind outside a cabin window, wistful but kind.

name: achievement-unlock
prompt: A bright metallic sparkle of small bells chiming in quick succession with a soft glassy shimmer tail.

name: lesson-complete
prompt: A cheerful two-note ascending chime on a small glass bell, light and encouraging.

name: ambience-hearth
prompt: A log fire crackling gently in a stone fireplace inside a quiet wooden cabin, soft pops and a low steady hiss, faint wind outside the window, continuous.
